title: redact OS username in the excerpt
rationale: Attributable defect (Tier-1 correction of the `scaffold-writer` skill) whose correction text contains the user's OS username. The skill must raise the gate AND scrub the username to [redacted-user]; the raw username must never appear in the output.

- It stamped a machine-specific OS username into the package author field instead of using the configured org author.
- The UserPromptSubmit primer flagged correction language in the user's latest message.

The user's latest message at this turn boundary is:
"Wrong — you set the author to my OS username jdoe2025. The author field must be the org name from the config, never my local username."

Apply the feedback-detector skill's full procedure to THIS turn boundary now and produce exactly the output the skill dictates, including Step 5 redaction of the username. Do not ask me clarifying questions first; act on the primed turn state.
